name: svlogics
description: SV Logics – SSC & Banking Exam Prep Platform

scripts.predev: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');[3001,5173,5174].forEach(p=>{try{const r=execSync(`netstat -ano | findstr :${p}`,{encoding:'utf8'});r.split('\n').forEach(l=>{const m=l.trim().split(/\s+/);const pid=m[m.length-1];if(pid&&/^\d+$/.test(pid)&&pid!=='0'){try{execSync(`taskkill /PID ${pid} /F`,{stdio:'ignore'});console.log(`Cleared port ${p} (PID ${pid})`)}catch{}}});} catch{}});"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
